summary: Preserved candidate PR 2808's requested-layer RunAI shard selection and corrected the independently reviewed incomplete-index counterexample. The selector now falls back to the complete prepared shard list whenever the index does not account for every prepared shard, including an mtp.safetensors deliberately appended by maybe_add_mtp_safetensors.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at exact candidate commit 8c799873170db6688e35734e591e36a5f188eaa5: the real compatibility helper auto-added mtp.safetensors, but the exact RunAI iterator input retained only draft-1.safetensors.
Passing-after regression: an incomplete index causes the exact RunAI iterator input to fall back to target.safetensors, draft-1.safetensors, and the auto-added mtp.safetensors.
Complete focused suite: 16 tests and 6 subtests passed, preserving native and Hugging Face selection, remote cached-index behavior, and all fallback cases.

gpu_execution.evidence: The affected behavior is deterministic JSON metadata parsing and Python file-list selection before the RunAI iterator. It performs no tensor computation, and GPU execution would not validate this contract.

remaining_limitations: No live object-storage credentials or large production MTP checkpoint were available; remote behavior is covered through URI-shaped paths and cached local index metadata rather than provider I/O counters.
No model weights were required or used. Distributed loading and end-to-end model semantic accuracy remain unverified.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
